newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish NTMA 100 mln punt auction cover 4.3 times.
newsitem.headline: Irish NTMA 100 mln punt auction cover 4.3 times.

text.p: Ireland's National Treasury Management Agency (NTMA) on Tuesday said a 100 million punt auction in the 8.25 percent Treasury bond due 2015 was covered 4.3 times.
The NTMA said the highest accepted price was 116.60 and the highest annual yield was 6.64 percent while the lowest accepted price was 116.45 and the lowest annual yield was 6.655 percent.
It said 45 percent of bids at the lowest price were filled.
The NTMA also announced that a non-competitive auction of 20 million punts for primary dealers was done at 116.48.
